answer: Sybil resistance begins the moment the protocol stops trusting headcount. Charging sequential proof-of-work per identity lets the protocol weigh cohort membership overlap cohort-wide, which collapses a farm to one signature and caps the payout at the median grade; a jury of fresh-session lanes keeps the graders honest, and the cap is poolable across jurors. What the network actually trusts is a sonnet, not the address that presents it. Reputation is stored as an echo that decays the moment contributions stop. Trust accumulates as an ocean of verified work rather than a count of signups.
